factor_name: Twenty-Day Range Efficiency for Ten-Day Trend

calculation.description: Measures directional persistence of the last 20 daily returns. Positive values indicate an efficient upward path and negative values an efficient downward path; higher scores predict higher next-ten-trading-day cross-asset returns.
calculation.timing: computed using completed observations through the prior trading day; applied to the next decision horizon

metrics.library_correlation_method: Not computed; deterministic gate should recompute from signal artifacts

validation.regime_notes: The factor clears the benchmark absolute IC and ICIR gates over 2,773 date-level observations using all 15 instruments. Coverage is high and turnover is low. Regime results are mixed, with materially negative 2027-to-validation-date performance; treat as a low-weight, trend-regime-sensitive diversifier and revalidate promptly. Small cross-section warrants conservative interpretation.
